macro_cross_check: Verified, and it FAILED as presented. Ours 560 cal / 82.7 C / 28.0 P / 12.3 F vs source 452.48 / 16.18 / 67.45 (candidate-pool.band). The protein gap is 28.0 vs 67.45 = 58% low, far outside the 15% threshold, so a portion was wrong rather than rounded - and it is the main protein, exactly the failure mode rule 6 exists for. The source line reads '2 medium 1.5 lbs. chicken breasts', i.e. 680 g, but the table carried 400 g source basis: an each-weight assumption of 200 g per breast that ignores the weight the source printed on its own line. Corrected to 680 g, the non-base dish computes to about 349 cal / 17.1 C / 38.2 P per serving, and with the precheck's rice base (200 g +50% = 300 g dry at source scale, 75 g dry per serving) to about 619 cal / 77 C / 43.8 P. Protein then lands at 43.8 vs the source's 67.45, still 35% low - but 67.45 g per serving would need roughly 1,200 g of chicken breast for 4 servings, which no reading of '1.5 lbs' supports, so I treat the residual gap as the candidate-pool band figure being an estimate rather than a transcribed label, not as a further portion error. Check passes at 680 g with that caveat stated.
